sloka: व्याहृतं दुर्वचो घोरं हन्तास्मि लवणं मृधे ।तस्यैवं मे दुरुक्तस्य दुर्गतिः पुरुषर्षभ ।। ७.६३.५ ॥
transliteration: vyāhṛtaṁ durvaco ghoraṁ hantāsmi lavaṇaṁ mṛdhe ।tasyaivaṁ me duruktasya durgatiḥ puruṣarṣabha ।। 7.63.5 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, I have uttered terrible, harsh words, saying "I will kill Lavana in battle," and such an ill-spoken word of mine will lead to misfortune.
